10.1 Vue d'ensemble

One ledger strip (net revenue of 30 days, active people…) and three work lists — cases waiting for review, content waiting for review, payment incidents — each shown only to admins whose grants cover it. No wall of numbers: it answers "what needs me today?". A failed file in the library links to its own type's list (audit fix A6).

10.2 Utilisateurs

  • Search box (debounced), filters by profession and status, « Charger plus » for the next 50.
  • A row opens the user drawer: « Profil », « Accès » (the AccessProfile and the facts it came from), « Abonnements », « Activité » (counts only — never what someone searched), « Historique » (audit entries of this account).
  • Actions in the drawer menu (with a reason): « Suspendre » / « Réactiver » the account, and sign it out of every device.

10.3 Vérifications

  • Queue tabs « En attente · Vérifiés · Rejetés · Expirés · Appels », type chips, oldest first; the « Soumis » column turns into a warning past the 24-hour SLA (with a word, never colour alone).
  • The case drawer: « Prendre le dossier » (claim), « Libérer » (give back), the documents with « Ouvrir » in the restricted viewer (60-second URL, watermark with the reviewer's name, printing and copying blocked, every opening audited; « Rouvrir » asks for a new link), then « Approuver » (optional expiry) or « Rejeter » (reason code).
  • An appeal can only be decided by a reviewer with verification.appeal.decide who did not reject the case.

10.4 Récupération

Assisted recovery requests by status. The drawer compares the request (lost contact, names, new contact) with the account found, shows the two photos (« Ouvrir », 60 seconds, audited) beside the verified identity, and offers « Approuver » (only when an account matches; applies after 24 h) or « Rejeter » — also during the 24-hour hold (audit fix A4).

10.5 Bibliothèque (ordonnances, certificats)

  • Type tabs (each has its own URL), status chips with counts, a filter box, « Ajouter un modèle ».
  • Upload drawer: drop or choose a PDF (checked in the browser: type, size, « %PDF » header); the French title is pre-filled from the file name; the button label follows the stage — checksum, sending, saving.
  • Model drawer: edit titles and « Échantillon démo » (« Enregistrer » asks for a reason), « Voir le PDF » (drawn on canvases, no download), « Remplacer le PDF », and the status menu (activate, deactivate, archive, restore). While a file is being processed the drawer refreshes every 3 seconds without erasing what the admin is typing.
  • « Synonymes »: extra words search should match for this model.

10.6 Calculateurs

The list shows each calculator's category, access, published and open version, primary source and status. « Nouveau calculateur » creates the calculator (slug, names, purpose, category). The detail page shows the version timeline and, for the selected version, five tabs:

TabButtons
DéfinitionRead-only view of inputs (ranges, units, answers and points), formula written with the inputs' names, bands and limitations; « Modifier la définition » opens the draft's JSON; « Enregistrer la définition » shows the API's problems by path.
Sources« Ajouter une source » (role, citation, edition, where the formula is stated, DOI or link, date accessed); bin icon to remove. Links must be http(s) (audit fix A1).
Tests« Ajouter un cas » (where the example comes from, inputs as JSON, expected outcome / value ± tolerance / band); « Lancer les tests » on the server engine.
RevueThe publication gate as a checklist; « Soumettre à revue », « Supprimer le brouillon » (author); « Approuver et publier » (or first/second sign-off) and « Renvoyer à l'auteur » (reviewer, never the author); « Retirer » a published version.
AperçuType values and « Calculer » on the server engine; nothing is stored.

10.7 Grossesse · Allaitement

  • Three tabs: Substances (search, filters by state and by conduct for a period, « Ajouter une substance », « Approuver les N affichées » for bulk review), Sources (the registry: « Ajouter une source », « Modifier »), Signalements (user reports; « Traiter » closes one with what was done).
  • The substance page: « Modifier la substance » (names, ATC, synonyms), « Nouvelle version », « Fusionner avec… » / « Annuler la fusion », the version timeline, and the profile editor (periods, conduct, evidence level and population, sources ticked, alternatives, conflicts between sources) with « Enregistrer le brouillon », « Soumettre à relecture », « Approuver et publier », « Demander des modifications ».
  • The import pages: « Choisir un fichier .xlsx », then a preview with column mapping (« Appliquer »), the meaning of each status word, rows with issues to correct one by one (« Enregistrer la ligne »), « Abandonner l'import » or « Ajouter à la bibliothèque » (writes drafts), and « Soumettre tout à relecture ».

10.8 Abonnements, Transactions, Finance

  • Abonnements — « Offres »: the versioned plan catalogue; « Nouveau forfait », « Nouvelle version » (a price change), « Mettre en vente » / « Retirer de la vente ». The plan drawer: code, names, price in dinars, duration, includes / not included (one per line), « Publier ». A second tab lists subscriptions.
  • Transactions: the immutable ledger with search and filters; the drawer shows the payment, its fee and adjustments; menu « Ajustement exceptionnel… » (Super Admin) and « Approuver » by a different admin.
  • Finance: the period picker; « Vue d'ensemble » (gross → fees → net, then expenses → net profit, subscriptions, revenue by plan, charts), « Dépenses » (« Ajouter une dépense », « Annuler la dépense », fee rates per channel with « Modifier », « Régler les frais » from a provider statement), « Moyens de paiement » (« Suspendre » / « Reprendre » a card network during an outage), « Rapports » (« Télécharger le CSV », audited).

10.9 Analytique and Journal d'audit

  • Analytique: period and segment filters (profession, specialty, wilaya); tabs Usage, Bibliothèque, Calculateurs, Utilisateurs (sign-up → verification funnel), Abonnements, Démo. Cells behind fewer than 10 people show « < 10 »; a freshness line says when the last event arrived.
  • Journal d'audit: filters (admin, action group, record, period), newest first, « Charger plus », « Exporter en CSV » (needs audit.export; the export itself is logged).

10.10 Permissions and Paramètres

  • Permissions (Super Admin): « Nouvel administrateur » (e-mail, name, preset) shows a one-time password once — « Copier », then « J'ai transmis le mot de passe ». The admin drawer: grants by area with live separation-of-duties checks, « Enregistrer les permissions », menu « Accès temporaire », « Réinitialiser l'authentificateur », « Suspendre » / « Réactiver ».
  • Paramètres: the pickers of the app (specialties, institutions, universities by wilaya: « Ajouter… ») and « Double relecture » — whether calculators and pregnancy profiles need one or two sign-offs (refused if fewer than two admins could approve).

11. How the mobile app is built — Flutter, Riverpod, go_router, drift

The app is written in Dart with Flutter, one code base for iOS and Android. Four libraries shape every file: Riverpod (state and dependencies), go_router (screens and redirects), dio with a generated client (the API), and drift (a small SQLite database on the phone). This chapter explains each with the app's own code.

11.1 The folders

lib/main.dart runApp(ProviderScope(DokToolApp)) lib/src/app.dart MaterialApp.router: themes, languages, router; wraps every screen with AnalyticsHost (screen views) and OfflineSyncHost (sync on resume) lib/src/core/ api/ (dio, interceptors, errors, generated client) · auth/ (session, vault) database/ (drift) · storage/ (Keychain/Keystore) · network/ · config/ lib/src/features/<feature>/ screens + their providers/controllers, one folder per feature lib/src/ui/ the widget kit: DtButton, DtAlert, DtBadge, DtTextField, ContentRow, locks… lib/src/theme/ doktool_tokens.dart (generated) + tokens.dart (context.colors…) lib/src/router/app_router.dart every route and the redirect rules lib/l10n/ ARB files built from packages/i18n → AppLocalizations

11.2 Start-up

Appearance (light, dark, system) and language (FR, EN) come from SettingsController and apply instantly. providerRetry makes Riverpod retry a failed load a few times — except when there is no network, where the screen says « Connexion requise » at once.

11.3 Riverpod in five minutes

A provider is a named piece of state or service. Widgets ref.watch(provider) to rebuild when it changes, or ref.read(provider) to use it once (in a button handler). The kinds used here:

KindExampleUsed for
ProviderapiProvider, appDatabaseProvider, offlineStoreProviderServices (one instance, injected).
FutureProviderwilayasProvider, legalProviderLoad once, show loading / error / data.
AsyncNotifierSessionController, AccessController, FavoritesController, OfflineSyncControllerState that loads and then changes through methods (toggle, reload, signOut).
NotifierOnboardingDraftController, PendingCheckoutControllerSynchronous state kept in memory.

Providers depend on each other: AccessController.build watches the session, so when the session changes (sign-in, sign-out, demo) the access profile reloads by itself:

In a screen, the three states are drawn with .when(...) or by reading .value, .isLoading, .hasError. Loading lists show skeleton rows, never a spinner (design section 22).

11.4 The session

Who is using the phone is a sealed class with three cases — the compiler forces every switch to handle all of them:

SessionVault keeps the secrets: refresh and renewal tokens in the Keychain / Keystore (SecureStore), the access token in memory only. When several requests need a new access token at once, they all wait for the same refresh ("single-flight") — refresh tokens are single-use, so two parallel refreshes would revoke the session:

The installation id that binds a session to the phone is created once; since the October audit concurrent first calls share one future, so they can never create two different ids (fix M1):

SessionController exposes the session to the app. Signing out — or the server ending the session — forgets everything personal left on the phone (fixes M2 and M3):

11.5 Routes and redirects

Every screen has a path in Routes. The redirect function decides, on every navigation and whenever the session or the account changes, where the person is allowed to be:

  • Signed out → only public pages (welcome, sign-in, sign-up, codes, demo start, recovery).
  • Demo → never public pages again, never account-only pages (subscription, profile edit, verification…).
  • Account without a profession → « Qui êtes-vous ? » first.
  • Locked content is never hidden by a redirect: the screen renders its locked state.

The three tabs (Accueil, Bibliothèque, Profil) are a StatefulShellRoute: each tab keeps its own stack, and tapping the active tab again goes back to its first screen. The round button in the middle of the bar opens search over everything; « Activité et favoris » is reached from Profil.

11.6 Talking to the API

The client under core/api/generated/ is produced from openapi.json by swagger_parser + build_runner: one method per endpoint (api.calculators.calculatorsControllerList()) and one immutable class per DTO. Two interceptors are added to dio: the language (Accept-Language) and the token (AuthInterceptor). Failures become an ApiError with the server's code; screens translate their specific codes and fall back to commonErrorText.

11.7 The local database (drift)

A small SQLite database keeps: device settings (key/value), offline documents, calculators and substances, and the analytics queue. Settings that belong to a person rather than the phone are listed so they can be forgotten at sign-out:

11.8 The widget kit and tokens

Screens are built from lib/src/ui/: DtButton (one primary per region, a spinner while loading, disabled when onPressed is null), DtTextField (label above, error on blur), DtAlert, DtBadge (always a word), ContentRow (a list row with its lock), DtPickerField (searchable bottom-sheet picker), DtSegmentedControl, DtPillTabs, DtChoiceList (long answers in full), the glass hero (DtGlass, DtHeroAppBar) and LockLabel / showLockSheet. Colours, spacing, radii and durations come only from tokens: context.colors.brand, DtSpace.s4, DtRadius.lg. CI rejects a raw colour literal.

11.9 Texts

Every text is AppLocalizations.of(context).someKey, generated from the ARB files that packages/i18n builds. To add a text: add the key in French and English to the catalogue, rebuild the ARB, run flutter gen-l10n (chapter 14).

11.10 Tests

apps/mobile/test/ has unit tests (engine, vectors, offline store, core) and widget tests that pump real screens with fake providers. accessibility_test.dart checks every main screen in light and dark, at 200 % text, for touch size (44 px), labels and contrast.

12. The mobile app, screen by screen

Every screen lives in apps/mobile/lib/src/features/<feature>/. For each: what it shows, every button and what it calls. The comments above each button in the code say the same thing in one line; Appendix A lists them with line numbers.

12.1 Welcome and onboarding (features/onboarding)

ScreenButtons and behaviour
Welcome welcome_screen.dart« Créer un compte », « Se connecter », « Essayer la démo ». On a phone that signed in before, « Se connecter » becomes the primary action and the identifier is pre-filled.
Démo demo_start_screen.dartChoose the context (doctor, resident, student) → « Commencer la démo » → SessionController.startDemo. No sign-up, no personal data.
Qui êtes-vous ? role_select_screen.dartOne role row per profession; « Continuer ». Before an account exists the choice waits in memory (OnboardingDraft); signed in, it is saved at once.
Créer un compte sign_up_screen.dartNames, e-mail or phone, password with strength line, wilaya picker, terms checkbox. Errors appear when a field is left, never per keystroke. « Créer mon compte » stays disabled until everything is valid. « Se connecter » if the account exists.
Code otp_screen.dartSix boxes over one hidden field (paste and SMS autofill work); « Vérifier »; « Renvoyer le code » with a 60-second countdown; after 3 wrong codes a 10-minute lock.
Se connecter sign_in_screen.dart« Se connecter », « Pas encore de compte ? », « Accès perdu ? », « Mot de passe oublié ? ». Messages for wrong password, lock until a time, unconfirmed, suspended.
Mot de passe oublié password_reset_screens.dart« Envoyer le code » (same answer whether or not the account exists), then code + new password → « Réinitialiser » → every device signs out.

12.2 The shell and Home

app_shell.dart draws the floating glass tab bar: « Accueil », « Bibliothèque », the round search button, « Profil » (with a dot when something needs attention, such as verification). home_screen.dart: the identity line (name, role, access; the bell opens notifications), the glass search field, a pregnancy search shortcut, the three resources as tiles, a verification line or « Voir les offres » depending on the access profile, and the recent items. Everything that can be opened comes from the AccessProfile — never from the profession.

12.3 Bibliothèque (features/library)

Pill tabs Ordonnances · Certificats · Calculateurs · Grossesse, a filter field scoped to the section, an A–Z list of ContentRows. A locked row keeps its place with its lock word; tapping it opens the lock sheet. Pull to refresh; « Réessayer » on error; offline, the list comes from the phone's store with the date of the copy. A library search is reported to analytics once typing pauses (the words themselves are never sent).

12.4 Recherche (features/search)

Full screen, keyboard up. Below two characters: recent searches (kept on the phone only; « Effacer », ✕ per item) and example queries. Then: results grouped by type (3 per group, « Voir les N »), type chips with counts, « Vouliez-vous dire … » suggestions, and offline results from the local store when the network fails. An answer arriving late for an older query is ignored.

12.5 Reading a reference PDF (features/reference)

reference_viewer_screen.dart downloads the PDF through a signed URL, checks its SHA-256 against the published one, and draws it with pdfrx. Floating control: page « 2 / 5 », zoom out, fit width, zoom in; the ★ in the top bar adds a favorite. There is no download, print or share button anywhere. Offline, the copy kept on the phone is used.

12.6 A calculator (features/calculators)

CalculatorRuntime: detail from API (or offline store) → parse definition → SELF-TEST the published cases ready → the form locked → lock message unsupported → "update the app" self-test failed → refuse form: number fields (with unit picker) · choice lists · yes/no switches typing → commit after 400 ms idle, "next", or leaving the field → evaluate() on the DEVICE result: value + unit + band, formula with the values, notes (« vérifiez la valeur »), conversions « Copier le résultat » (value, unit, band — never the inputs) · « Réinitialiser » · « Source » sheet

The last values typed are kept on the phone (to find them again after a call) and are forgotten at sign-out. They are never sent anywhere.

12.7 Grossesse · Allaitement (features/pregnancy)

  • Search (pregnancy_search.dart): server search after a 300 ms pause; a period filter (T1, T2, T3, peripartum, lactation) shows each hit's conduct for that period; « Afficher N de plus ».
  • Profile (substance_screen.dart): a switch Grossesse / Allaitement; period tabs; for each period a conduct badge (icon + word) and, separately, the evidence meter (0–4) with population and sources; « Absence de données » as a full block; alternatives (each opens its profile); conflicts between sources; sources with links; « Signaler une erreur » (reason + optional comment; no patient data). A locked profile shows « Débloquer » with its explanation.

12.8 Activité et favoris (features/activity)

Two segments. « Favoris »: grouped by type, « Retirer » on each. « Activité »: the person's own history grouped by day, with filters by kind and « Effacer l'historique » (confirmation sheet). History is recorded on the phone and sent in batches; a demo records nothing.

12.9 Profil, Paramètres, Sécurité (features/profile, settings)

  • Profil: photo or initials, name, role, verification and access badges, « Modifier le profil » (names, photo « Changer » / « Supprimer », bio ≤ 280), then Activité et favoris, Abonnement (students: « Accès étudiant — gratuit »), Vérification, Notifications, Paramètres, « Se déconnecter ».
  • Paramètres: Apparence (Clair · Sombre · Appareil) and Langue (Français · English), applied at once; « Données et hors ligne »; « Sécurité du compte »; « Supprimer mon compte ».
  • Sécurité du compte: the e-mail and phone with « Modifier » / « Ajouter » / « Retirer » (password + code to the new contact), « Changer le mot de passe », and, during a recovery's 24-hour hold, « Ce n'est pas moi ».
  • Supprimer mon compte: what is erased, what the law keeps, the end of a current subscription without refund, then the password.

12.10 Vérification (features/verification)

StepWhat happens
IntroWhy, what is checked, where documents go, how long; « Commencer »; « Plus tard » always available.
1 · IdentitéDocument kind (ID card, passport, student card); « Prendre une photo » opens the camera with corner guides, then « Utiliser la photo » / « Reprendre ». On the phone, ML Kit reads the text: too little text is « illisible », the name must appear — the person can still « Envoyer quand même ». « Importer un fichier » accepts PDF, JPG, PNG.
2 · StatutDoctor: Ordre number, specialty, attestation or diploma. Resident: year, institution, specialty, attestation. Student: university and proof of enrolment.
3 · RécapitulatifCheckmarks and file descriptions only; « Envoyer pour vérification ».
StatutEach case with its timeline (Reçu → En cours de revue → Décision), the refusal reason in plain words and one action: Commencer, Continuer, Corriger, Faire appel, Renouveler; « ⋮ » → « Effacer mes documents ».

12.11 Abonnement (features/subscription)

  • Offres: each plan's includes / not included, duration, price, access; the button depends on eligibility: « Choisir », or verification first, or (demo) « Créer un compte ». Students see an explanation, never a purchase.
  • Récapitulatif: plan, price, period, card (CIB or Edahabia — only those the API accepts now), access, manual renewal, the « non remboursable » line to tick; « Payer » opens the gateway's page in the browser.
  • Résultat du paiement: asks the API every 4 seconds and on return to the app until the payment is final — the API asks the gateway, never trusting the browser. « Voir mon abonnement », « Réessayer », « Autre moyen de paiement », « Rouvrir la page de paiement ».
  • Mon abonnement: plan, neutral or teal status badge, period, payments; « Renouveler » (last 14 days), « Arrêter le renouvellement ». No red, no countdown.

12.12 Accès perdu ? (features/recovery)

Three ways back in: « Mot de passe oublié » (code), « J'ai changé de contact » (sign in with the other one), « J'ai perdu l'accès aux deux » (assisted recovery: form → code to the new contact → identity photo + selfie → « Envoyer la demande » → answer within 72 h, applied 24 h after approval).

12.13 Données et hors ligne (features/offline)

Last sync, data version, storage used; « Tout » or « Favoris seulement »; mobile data on/off; « Mettre à jour maintenant »; « Supprimer les données hors ligne ». A bar under the status bar says offline, syncing, failed (« Réessayer ») or outdated.

12.14 Notifications

Newest first; unread ones with a dot; tapping marks one read and opens its link; « Tout marquer comme lu ». Texts come from catalogue keys with parameters, so they follow the app's language.

13. Eight journeys through the whole system

Each journey follows one real story from the first tap to the database and back, naming the file at every step. Read one with the three apps open side by side: it is the fastest way to feel how the pieces fit.

13.1 A doctor joins, gets verified and subscribes

MOBILE API ADMIN WEB welcome_screen « Créer un compte » role_select_screen DOCTOR (in memory) sign_up_screen ─ POST /v1/auth/sign-up ─► AuthService.signUp → OtpService.issue → SMS/e-mail otp_screen ───── POST …/sign-up/confirm ► confirmSignUp → session + tokens; DemoService.markConverted └── POST /v1/me/professional-profile (DOCTOR) UsersService verification_intro → identity_step (camera, ML Kit check) POST /v1/me/verification/cases …/uploads → signed PUT → R2 doktool-private → …/documents (confirm) status_step (Ordre number, specialty, attestation) → saveDetails summary_screen « Envoyer » ─────────────► VerificationService.submit (SUBMITTED) Vérifications queue (SLA 24 h) « Prendre le dossier » (claim) restricted viewer (60 s, audited) VerificationReviewService.approve ◄─ « Approuver » profile ← role + details; notification; audit entry notification « Vérification approuvée » AccessService → tier PROFESSIONAL_UNPAID, purchase OPEN plans_screen « Choisir » → review_screen « Payer » ─► CheckoutService.start → Chargily page browser pays on the gateway's page payment_result_screen polls ─────────────► settle → gateway.status = PAID → activate subscription access reloads → tier PROFESSIONAL: every model, calculator and profile opens; offline sync starts

13.2 A visitor tries the demo, then creates an account

  1. demo_start_screen → POST /v1/demo/sessions with the installation id → a one-hour demo token + renewal token (SessionVault.saveDemo).
  2. The router moves to Home; GET /v1/me/access answers tier DEMO: only demoSample items open; offline, purchase and profile edit are locked with « Créer un compte » as the unlock path.
  3. Analytics: DEMO_STARTED, then DEMO_FEATURE_VIEWED for each module seen or limit met (no account, no personal data).
  4. « Créer un compte » → sign-up → on confirmation the same installation id marks the demo CONVERTED; the « Démo » funnel in Admin Web counts it.

13.3 Opening a prescription model

Chapter 3.1 followed this request byte by byte. The things to remember: the list shows locked models in place; file-url re-checks access; the PDF comes straight from R2 with a 10-minute URL; its SHA-256 is checked on the phone; ActivityRecorder.referenceViewed adds a history entry; REFERENCE_VIEWED is counted once the PDF has rendered.

13.4 Using a calculator, offline

  1. During the last sync, OfflineSyncController stored the published calculator version (definition + test cases) in drift.
  2. No network: calculatorRuntimeProvider reads the stored version, parses it (definition.dart) and runs its published test cases on the Dart engine (self_test.dart). A failure refuses the calculator.
  3. The doctor types the age, weight, creatinine; each field commits after a pause; evaluate() checks ranges and rules and computes; the band and the formula with the values appear.
  4. Nothing leaves the phone. CALCULATOR_COMPLETED is queued for analytics with the calculator id and version only.

13.5 Authoring and publishing a calculator (two admins)

Author (calculators.draft) Reviewer (calculators.review + publish), NOT the author « Nouveau calculateur » → createCalculator « Nouvelle version » → createVersion (DRAFT) Définition: JSON from the cited source → saveDefinition (checkDefinition) Sources: PRIMARY source (+ validation sources) Tests: cases from the source → « Lancer les tests » (TS engine, stored with checksum) « Soumettre à revue » → submit (gate re-checked) ─► IN_REVIEW reads definition, sources, tests; « Aperçu » « Approuver et publier » + written note publish: tests re-run, four-eyes, sign-offs (policy 2 → first sign-off; second reviewer publishes) PUBLISHED: immutable; audit entries all along Phones: next list / sync → new version, self-tested before use

13.6 Pregnancy profiles from a spreadsheet

  1. « Importer un fichier » → the XLSX is read on the server without running anything in it (workbook.ts reads the XML inside the zip).
  2. The header row is found, columns mapped, status words listed; each row checked against the current library (duplicates, unknown alternatives).
  3. The admin maps columns and status words, corrects rows, then « Ajouter à la bibliothèque » → draft profile versions, all or nothing, idempotent on double click.
  4. Authors complete evidence levels and explanations; « Soumettre à relecture »; a different admin approves; only then do phones see the profiles.

13.7 Lost both e-mail and phone

Mobile access_help_screen → recovery_screen (form, code to the new contact, two photos to the private bucket, « Envoyer la demande ») → Admin Web « Récupération » (compare, « Approuver » with a note) → 24-hour hold, owner notified on the old contacts → auth.account-recovery job: claim, replace contacts, password unusable, all sessions revoked → the person signs in with the new contact through « Mot de passe oublié ».

13.8 A subscription reaches its end

  1. 14 and 3 days before the end: notifications « Votre abonnement se termine bientôt » (SubscriptionLifecycleService.remind). « Renouveler » is open in the last 14 days; a renewal extends from the current end.
  2. At the end without renewal: GRACE for 7 days, access kept (advance).
  3. After grace: EXPIRED. placeInTier gives PROFESSIONAL_UNPAID; the doctor keeps the sample set and favorites; offline copies of locked items are removed at the next sync.
  4. Never: red banners, countdowns, refund buttons.

14. Working on the code: tests, CI and recipes

You now know where everything is. This last chapter is practical: how to check your work, and the exact steps for the changes you will make most often.

14.1 Before every commit

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://…/doktool_test npm run ci # format, lint, types, i18n, tokens, contract, all tests cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test npm run build -w @doktool/admin # when Admin Web changed
Use a dedicated test database. Integration tests do not roll back. A test that changes something platform-wide (for example the double sign-off policy) must put it back, as clinical-review.e2e.spec.ts does.

14.2 Recipe: add an API endpoint

  1. Write the service method in the module that owns the data (with a one-line comment).
  2. Add the DTO classes (@ApiProperty + class-validator decorators).
  3. Add the controller method with the right guard: UserAuthGuard, ViewerAuthGuard, @RequireFeature or @RequireGrants. Admin changes call AuditService.record with the reason.
  4. Write an integration test in apps/api/test/integration.
  5. Regenerate the contract and both clients:
npm run openapi:generate -w @doktool/api npm run generate:api -w @doktool/admin cd apps/mobile && dart run swagger_parser && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs

14.3 Recipe: add a column or a table

  1. Edit apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma in the section of the owning module (// ── [module] ──); a unit test checks table ownership.
  2. Write the migration by hand in prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_<name>/migration.sql. An enum ADD VALUE goes in its own migration.
  3. Indexes written in SQL (trigram, partial) are also declared in the schema, or prisma migrate diff will propose to drop them. Check with npx prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code.
  4. npm run prisma:migrate:deploy -w @doktool/api, then prisma generate runs on install.

14.4 Recipe: add or change a text

// keys.json { "fr": { "mobile.home.newKey": "Bonjour" }, "en": { "mobile.home.newKey": "Hello" }, "remove": [] } npm run add-keys -w @doktool/i18n -- keys.json npm run build:arb -w @doktool/i18n cd apps/mobile && flutter gen-l10n

Admin Web reads the catalogue directly; mobile uses AppLocalizations.of(context).homeNewKey. CI fails if a key exists in one language only.

14.5 Recipe: add a mobile screen

  1. Create the screen in lib/src/features/<feature>/, built from lib/src/ui widgets and tokens only.
  2. Add its path to Routes and a GoRoute in app_router.dart; if it is for real accounts only, add it to Routes.accountOnly.
  3. Load data through a provider; draw loading (skeleton), error (« Réessayer ») and empty states.
  4. Locked things stay visible: use the AccessProfile, LockLabel and showLockSheet.
  5. Add a widget test, and the screen to accessibility_test.dart.
  6. Format with dart format --page-width 120 (never on doktool_tokens.dart).

14.6 Recipe: add an Admin Web section

  1. The API endpoints with @RequireGrants; a new grant goes in grants.ts and its label in features/permissions/grants.ts (the build fails until it is labelled).
  2. src/features/<section>/: the page, its drawers and dialogs, labels.ts for status names and tones.
  3. src/app/admin/<section>/page.tsx wrapping it in <RequireGrant>, and a link in shell/nav.ts.
  4. Every change asks for a reason (ReasonDialog) and shows a toast on success.

14.7 Adding a calculator is not a code change

A new calculator is data, entered in Admin Web by a doctor from a cited source (chapter 13.5), reviewed by someone else, and published. No deployment is needed: phones receive it at their next list or sync. The engines change only when a new kind of operator or input is needed — then both engines, checkDefinition, the shared vectors and the version number of the engine change together.

14.8 The checklist that keeps DokTool safe

RuleWhere it is enforced
Every endpoint re-checks access@RequireFeature, AccessService.decideItems, @RequireGrants
No patient data, no free text in analyticsanalytics.policy.ts schemas; calculator inputs never sent
Files only through StorageService, signed and short-livedstorage.policy.ts, ESLint import rule
Tokens: access in memory, refresh in Keychain/Keystore, single-use, device-boundsession_vault.dart, sessions.service.ts
Admin: cookie + TOTP, writes only from Admin Web, separation of dutiesadmin-guards.ts, grants.ts
Clinical content: sourced, tested, author ≠ reviewer, immutablecalculators-admin.service.ts, pregnancy-admin.service.ts, database constraints
Every admin change audited, log append-onlyAuditService, table triggers
CSV cells cannot run as formulascommon/text/csv.ts

14.9 What the October 2026 audit changed

The full report is docs/CODE-AUDIT-2026-10.md. In short: eighteen defects fixed with tests (the most serious: re-verification dropping a paying doctor's access, and a race in account recovery), performance of the offline manifest and favorites improved about tenfold, comments added to every function and button of the three apps, and six recommendations recorded for decisions that need the Product Owner or a real R2 bucket.

14.10 Rebuilding this book

python3 docs/learning-book/build.py # HTML + PDF, English and Arabic (needs Chrome) python3 docs/learning-book/build.py --html # HTML only

Chapters are in docs/learning-book/content/en and content/ar; folder introductions in folders.json. Code excerpts and Appendix A are read from the sources at build time, so after a code change, rebuilding is enough to bring the book up to date. A placeholder whose anchor no longer exists stops the build with its name, so nothing goes silently stale.
